_comment: AI traffic. Bangladesh drives on the LEFT. lanes = distance of each lane from the middle of the road (inner = fast lane for cars, outer = slow lane for rickshaws, buses, CNGs). How many vehicles drive around is set per graphics level in data/quality.json (traffic / parked). spawn = where they appear/disappear around the player (metres). signals = junctions let north-south and east-west traffic go in turns (seconds). ai = how drivers behave. mix = which vehicles drive in each district (weights; names from data/vehicles.json) and density (1 = the full number). jams = permanently crowded junctions (col/row of the city grid): more vehicles, slower, longer waits; jamSpawnShare = share of new vehicles that appear on the roads leading into a nearby jam. busStops = one stop on every Nth road side (shelter + buses and legunas pull up).

ai._comment: lookAhead = how far along the lane a driver aims (seconds of travel, limited to min/max metres). senseSeconds/senseMin = how far ahead he watches for obstacles. minGap = distance he keeps when stopped. turnSpeed = top speed inside a junction. honkAfter = seconds stuck before honking (queuePatience = how much slower that clock runs when he is only queuing behind other AI traffic); pushAfter = seconds stuck before he squeezes through anyway; giveUpAfter = seconds stuck before he is quietly removed (only when the player is not close).

riderArchetypes._comment: Who is seen riding open vehicles (names from data/pedestrians.json).
